title: Exporting Custom Resource On A [Tool] Annotated Script In C# Throws Error Related To Casting
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: v4.6.2.stable.mono.official [71f334935] ### System information Godot v4.6.2.stable.mono - macOS Tahoe (26.5.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M4 Pro (Apple9) - Apple M4 Pro (14 threads) - 24.00 GiB memory ### Issue description I'd like to leverage the `[Tool]` annotation on one of my scripts so that updating exported properties like `Texture2D` -- as an exmaple, is immediately reflected in the Godot Viewport (may be wrong terminology). One of the `[Export]` types I'd like to use is a custom resource (inheriting from `Resource`), where in the scripts `_Ready()` method, the values from the given resource are parsed to add/update a `Sprite2D`'s `Texture2D` for example and show this in the Godot Viewport. I noticed that this seems to work when I don't include the `[Tool]` annotation on my script, but results in the following error when the `[Tool]` annotation is included. ``` ERROR: /root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/NativeInterop/ExceptionUtils.cs:113 - System.InvalidCastException: Unable to cast object of type 'Godot.Resource' to type 'ResourceIssue.CustomResource'. ERROR: at CustomSceneWithScript.SetGodotClassPropertyValue(godot_string_name& name, godot_variant& value) in /Users/jeffreydaye/Projects/ResourceIssue/.godot/mono/temp/obj/Debug/Godot.SourceGenerators/Godot.SourceGenerators.ScriptPropertiesGenerator/CustomSceneWithScript_ScriptProperties.generated.cs:line 21 ERROR: at Godot.Bridge.CSharpInstanceBridge.Set(IntPtr godotObjectGCHandle, godot_string_name* name, godot_variant* value) in /root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/Bridge/CSharpInstanceBridge.cs:line 57 ``` I did find a similar (if not identical) issue that has been closed in [#69356](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/69356). I fear this could be user error, as maybe I am doing something outside of expected bounds. Let me know how I could help figure this out, or what I may be doing wrong. Maybe I am misusing resources with the `[Tool]` annotation in an unexpected way? ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create a blank Scene from a `Node2D` (can likely be any type, but `Node2D` I tested with. 2. Create a custom resource type -- a class inheriting from Godot `Resource` annotated with `[GlobalClass]` -- as documented [here](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/scripting/resources.html#creating-your-own-resources). 3. Create a custom C# script and apply it to the scene in *Step `*, add the `[Tool]` annotation. 4. On the same script, add the `[Export]` annotation with the exported properties type being the custom resource type created in *Step 2* -- Basic C# export usage is [here](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/scripting/c_sharp/c_sharp_exports.html#basic-use) 5. Create and save a .tres file using your custom resource type. 6. In Godot, open the Scene with the applied custom scripts that's been updated to export your custom resource and attempt to either: 1) Attempt to create the desired resource from the inspector drop down like shown in "Drop-down Example", or 2) Attempt to Quick Load or Drag-and-Drop your previously created .tres file into the field in the inspector. The resulting error after step 6 appears in Godots `Output` terminal and looks as follows: ``` ERROR: /root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/NativeInterop/ExceptionUtils.cs:113 - System.InvalidCastException: Unable to cast object of type 'Godot.Resource' to type 'ResourceIssue.CustomResource'. ERROR: at CustomSceneWithScript.SetGodotClassPropertyValue(godot_string_name& name, godot_variant& value) in /Users/jeffreydaye/Projects/ResourceIssue/.godot/mono/temp/obj/Debug/Godot.SourceGenerators/Godot.SourceGenerators.ScriptPropertiesGenerator/CustomSceneWithScript_ScriptProperties.generated.cs:line 21 ERROR: at Godot.Bridge.CSharpInstanceBridge.Set(IntPtr godotObjectGCHandle, godot_string_name* name, godot_variant* value) in /root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/Bridge/CSharpInstanceBridge.cs:line 57 ``` This error does not occur when the `[Tool]` annotation is removed. Drop-down Example *This could very well be user error, if so, please advise. I believe I remember being able to do this in early versions of Godot 4.x* ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [ResourceIssueMinimal.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28063750/ResourceIssueMinimal.zip)
